steps.en: Clone the repository and run its setup once
steps.zh: 克隆仓库并跑一次安装

steps.en: Open the project in your coding assistant — the agent is the orchestrator
steps.zh: 在编程助手里打开项目，agent 就是编排器

steps.en: Describe the video in plain language
steps.zh: 用自然语言描述要什么视频
steps.code: Make a 60-second animated explainer about how neural networks learn

steps.en: Reads the pipeline manifest: stages, tools, review criteria and success gates
steps.zh: 读管线清单：阶段、工具、评审标准与成功门

steps.en: Runs the stages — research, script, scene plan, assets, edit, compose
steps.zh: 依次跑各阶段：研究、脚本、分镜、素材、剪辑、合成

steps.en: Stops for approval with a cost estimate before spending on paid APIs
steps.zh: 花付费 API 之前先给成本估算并等你确认

steps.en: Approve, and let it render through Remotion or HyperFrames
steps.zh: 确认后让它用 Remotion 或 HyperFrames 渲染

value.en: A finished, narrated video from one sentence — with checkpoints and cost control instead of a hired studio
value.zh: 一句话得到配好音的成片，有检查点和成本控制，不需要请工作室

sources: README Quick Start (git clone ... && make setup; 前置要求 Python 3.10+ / FFmpeg / Node.js 18+ / AI 编程助手; 示例指令 "Make a 60-second animated explainer about how neural networks learn")
README Pipelines (pipeline_defs/*.yaml 共 13 个清单，含 framework-smoke；阶段流 research -> proposal -> script -> scene_plan -> assets -> edit -> compose)
README How It Works (没有 code orchestrator，AI 编程助手就是编排器；agent 读 YAML 管线清单与 Markdown 导演技能，再调用 Python 工具，并在花费前请求人工批准)
README Pipelines 表 (渲染后端为 Remotion / HyperFrames)
